subject: Paragraph text box in shiny that tab autocompletes certain words from a known list on cue

messages.author: 276beb20b840713c
messages.subject: Paragraph text box in shiny that tab autocompletes certain words from a known list on cue
parts:
I am trying to implement an idea in shiny where a user has to type in a block (paragraph) of free-form text but on certain words (the more difficult technical ones, say chemical names) he gets the option of auto-completing from a known list of likely options. This could either be triggered by a tab press (like in RStudio's syntax completion) or by another keystroke or even simply by a certain wait etc. 

Are there any apps that have already implemented such functionality? I'd be curious to see how they did it. 

Any other ideas?
